scope: Long-only offline research decision. This file is not an inference bundle and must not alter live trading, MC1, admission, portfolio, or execution.

canonical_research_contract.route: timestamp-local top 30 percent on enhanced-base score

strict_evaluation.train: six complete months before a 28-day reserve; only resolved semantic labels

strict_evaluation.limitation: Two held months are sufficient for a controlled candidate audit but insufficient to claim cross-era portability or authorize a live replacement.
